Conservation of mass means that if you've got a sealed box, you shouldn't expect there to be more or less mass in there each time you check. The amount of stuff you have will stay constant with respect to time.

Currently we can only see these things happening in extremely small spaces at extremely small timeframes along massive energy densities or gradients. That is to say, it's a super tiny thing that happens only when you put normal stuff under a shit ton of energy.
